## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences: what changes for someone using IMBONIX, and why. -->

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Data or methodology
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI or tooling

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass in `apps/web`
- [ ] `npm test` passes in `apps/api` (if the API changed)
- [ ] Pages touched were checked on a phone-width screen and with the keyboard
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visible changes

## Data and honesty checks

- [ ] Every new number traces to a published NISR source, and its source line names it
- [ ] Values are labelled with their status (observed, calculated, model estimate, projection, scenario or policy target)
- [ ] No causal claims from cross-sectional data
- [ ] No microdata, personal data, credentials or `.env` files are included
- [ ] Nothing implies that NISR endorses IMBONIX
